messages.subject: display data from rmysql to shiny app error
parts:
Hi,
i have created a table student(studName,address,mobNo,email,gender,college,course,category)
category is NRI and INDIAN.
I want to retrieve data of student who are NRI or INDIAN.
I made UI.R and Server.R file

ui.R
library(shiny)
library(RMySQL)
shinyUI(fluidPage(
  titlePanel("More Widgets"),
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      selectInput("category", "Choose a category:",
                  choices = c("INDIAN", "NRI")),
      actionButton("display","Update View")
    ),
 
    mainPanel(
      h4("Observations"),
      tableOutput("view")
    )
  )
))

server.R

shinyServer(function(input, output) {
  # Return the requested dataset
  datasetInput <- reactive({
    switch(input$category,
           "INDIAN" = as.character(INDIAN),
           "NRI" = as.character(NRI))
    input$display
    if(input$display==0)
    return()
    else
    isolate(paste(con<-dbConnect(dbDriver("MySQL"),user="root",password="root",dbname="rprog",host="localhost"),
    query <- paste("select * from student where category='",as.character(input$category),"');",sep=""),
    res<-dbGetQuery(con,query),
    fetch(res),
    sep=""
    ))
  })
  
   
 
 
  output$view <- renderTable({
   
    head(datasetInput())
    })
   # head(datasetInput())
 
})

after running app using runApp("dataset1")
I am getting error as
Error in .func() : object 'INDIAN' not found


Please help!!
regards,
kriti

Hi,
thanx joe!! 

that problem is solved but now i am facing different problem..

Error in as.character.default(<S4 object of class structure("MySQLConnection", package = "RMySQL")>) : 
  no method for coercing this S4 class to a vector

I tried using as.character or as.data.frame.. but the same error!!



On Thu, Mar 5, 2015 at 8:50 PM, Joe Cheng <j...@rstudio.com> wrote:
Remove these lines, they aren't doing anything:

switch(input$category,
           "INDIAN" = as.character(INDIAN),
           "NRI" = as.character(NRI))

Add these in their place:

if (!isTRUE(input$category %in% c("INDIAN", "NRI"))) { 
  stop("Invalid category selected")
}

This is to prevent a malicious user from sneaking a dangerous SQL command into input$category.
